definitions.explanation: The detailed examination of something to understand its nature, structure, or components.

examples.japanese: {データ}を{分析|ぶんせき}する。
{原因|げんいん}を{詳|くわ}しく{分析|ぶんせき}した。
examples.english: I analyzed the cause in detail.

examples.japanese: {市場|しじょう}{分析|ぶんせき}の{結果|けっか}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: The results of the market analysis came out.

notes:
USAGE: {分析|ぶんせき} is used in academic, scientific, and business contexts for systematic examination.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{分析|ぶんせき}する (to analyze)
・{分析|ぶんせき}を{行|おこな}う (to conduct analysis)
・{分析|ぶんせき}{結果|けっか} (analysis results)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{市場|しじょう}{分析|ぶんせき} (market analysis)
・{データ}{分析|ぶんせき} (data analysis)
・{化学|かがく}{分析|ぶんせき} (chemical analysis)
・{分析|ぶんせき}{力|りょく} (analytical ability)
・{精密|せいみつ}{分析|ぶんせき} (precise analysis)
